description_en: Queries the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instances attached to a specified backend server
description_zh: 查询指定后端服务器绑定的全球加速实例
name: DescribeServerRelatedGlobalAccelerationInstances

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance resides. 

You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
全球加速实例所在的地域。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backend service instance
parameters.name: server_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the backend service instance. Valid values: 

EcsInstance (default): ECS instance.

SlbInstance: load balancing instance
parameters.help_zh:
后端服务实例的类型，取值： 

EcsInstance（默认值）：ECS实例

SlbInstance：负载均衡实例
parameters.name: server_type

GlobalAccelerationInstance.description_en: The list of Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instances
GlobalAccelerationInstance.description_zh: 全球加速实例信息列表

GlobalAccelerationInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance

IpAddress.description_en: The public IP address of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
IpAddress.description_zh: 全球加速实例公网 IP

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
RegionId.description_zh: 全球加速实例所属地域ID

ServerIpAddress.description_en: The IP address of the backend server
